突发：中国财经媒体爆料，黄仁勋已被英伟达董事会罢免！？？？

据中国财经媒体「金角财经」进一步爆料称，英伟达董事会已经批准黄仁勋辞职，并决定由印度裔高管 Jay Puri 接任 CEO。

我去查了一下这个人的背景，发现还挺有意思的。
Jay Puri，全名 Ajay K. Puri，是英伟达的一位老将，今年 2 月英伟达的年报显示他已经 71 岁了。
他本科毕业于明尼苏达大学电气工程专业，硕士毕业于加州理工学院，后来又拿到了哈佛商学院的 MBA。

在加入英伟达之前，他曾经在 Sun Microsystems 工作了整整 22 年，先后担任日本子公司总裁、全球软件与技术销售副总裁，以及亚太区高级副总裁。

更早之前，他还在惠普、德州仪器和博思艾伦咨询公司工作过。
2005 年，Jay Puri 正式加入英伟达，担任全球销售高级副总裁。
2009 年晋升为全球业务运营执行副总裁，负责英伟达的全球销售、业务拓展、合作伙伴关系、解决方案工程和客户支持等业务。
可以说，他亲历了英伟达从一家以游戏显卡闻名的公司，逐渐发展为全球 AI 基础设施巨头的整个过程。

不过，这里有一个非常奇怪的地方。
Jay Puri 其实今年就已经退休了。
根据英伟达今年 7 月提交给美国 SEC 的正式文件，他在 6 月底提出卸任，8 月 24 日正式离开全球业务运营执行副总裁的岗位，转任公司高级顾问。
接替他原有职务的是此前在微软工作了 26 年的 Nicholas Parker。
也就是说，这次被传将接替黄仁勋的人，实际上是一位已经退出日常管理岗位的 71 岁老将。

我去查了一圈海外媒体和社交平台，目前还没有找到这条任命消息的独立证实。
所以目前这件事仍然有很大疑问。
黄仁勋的 CEO 职位确实面临危机，但 Jay Puri 接任的消息，截至目前尚未得到英伟达官方或主流英文媒体证实。
如果最终真的由这位已经卸任的老将接班，那也将是英伟达一次相当出人意料的管理层变动。

我会继续关注后续公告。

PS：我查了下似乎最早是雪球的爆料🤔

A big Chinese lab reached out to me asking for help distilling Fable into their model. I said no.

I told them to use the millions of books that have no copyright instead. Offered to help pick them and to help train the model a different way. They only wanted distillation, which tells you a lot about the mindset there.

I've worked deep in this field and distillation is real. I wasn't convinced at one point. What I saw changed my mind completely.

I'm the biggest supporter of open source. I'm for releasing weights and for the freedom to research and build, because humanity only grows when knowledge gets shared. But let's be logical.

Nobody will convince me that labs shipping a model every month or less, each one a big leap, now can't ship a better one after three months.

Kimi K3.1 Pro isn't a big leap over Kimi K3 and it's been about 100 days.

DeepSeek still can't put out a respectable Pro model.

Zai used to release their strongest model in under two months. It's been three with nothing.

All I hear about Qwen 4 Max is that it's a letdown.

Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek Flash both show traces of Astra distillation. The leak showed Moonshot used it, and so did DeepSeek.

If this isn't the effect of Anthropic blocking distillation then what is it?

Chinese labs need to get serious about using the talented researchers they have and give their models an identity. Right now their models at their best are a cheaper alternative. I want them out of that box. I want to see what makes them different.

Anthropic has crossed lines too, no argument there. They destroyed millions of books, human knowledge that was in people's hands, and kept it for themselves. I'll never forgive them for that.

But Chinese labs rely on distillation more than they rely on better data.

I didn't work with them. Transparency and honesty matter to me, like you've known since I started here.

做个带真地图的小工具，终于不用先绑外币信用卡了

以前往网页里接张能查店、算路线的 Google 地图，代码没写一行，先要去云后台建项目、绑卡、开权限折腾半小时...
现在在 Google AI Studio 里用大白话提句需求，点一下启用，它自己就会生成免绑卡的演示密钥锁进后台配置，右边直接跑起能拖拽缩放的 2D/3D 真地图

四路实时地理数据直接调
接上的是实时全球数据库，能做写实 3D 城市航拍、附近门店筛选、多车队多站点排线，还能拉取空气质量和花粉浓度（内置防瞎编核实，防止 AI 凭空捏造假地址或关门店铺）

单接口每天免费调 100 次
每个地图 API 每天有 100 次免费额度，每 24 小时重置。就算代码写死循环刷爆了也只是暂停报错，绝不扣费（仅限个人 Gmail 账号，且免费钥匙拿不到顾客拍的门店照片和文字评论）

纯新号比老号免费权限更大

A big Chinese lab reached out to me asking for help distilling Fable into their model. I said no.

I told them to use the millions of books that have no copyright instead. Offered to help pick them and to help train the model a different way. They only wanted distillation, which tells you a lot about the mindset there.

I've worked deep in this field and distillation is real. I wasn't convinced at one point. What I saw changed my mind completely.

I'm the biggest supporter of open source. I'm for releasing weights and for the freedom to research and build, because humanity only grows when knowledge gets shared. But let's be logical.

Nobody will convince me that labs shipping a model every month or less, each one a big leap, now can't ship a better one after three months.

Kimi K3.1 Pro isn't a big leap over Kimi K3 and it's been about 100 days.

DeepSeek still can't put out a respectable Pro model.

Zai used to release their strongest model in under two months. It's been three with nothing.

All I hear about Qwen 4 Max is that it's a letdown.

Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek Flash both show traces of Astra distillation. The leak showed Moonshot used it, and so did DeepSeek.

If this isn't the effect of Anthropic blocking distillation then what is it?

Chinese labs need to get serious about using the talented researchers they have and give their models an identity. Right now their models at their best are a cheaper alternative. I want them out of that box. I want to see what makes them different.

Anthropic has crossed lines too, no argument there. They destroyed millions of books, human knowledge that was in people's hands, and kept it for themselves. I'll never forgive them for that.

But Chinese labs rely on distillation more than they rely on better data.

I didn't work with them. Transparency and honesty matter to me, like you've known since I started here.

- Starlink Mini 2 is up for preorder with a quick-swap battery that lasts up to 4.5 hours.

META 🔥:

- Muse can now book Uber Courier deliveries in chat.

MICROSOFT 🔥:
- Gemini 4 Carbon is generally available in GitHub Copilot.

PERPLEXITY 🔥:
- Gemini 4 Carbon is in Perplexity Computer and matches Claude Fable 5.2 on WANDR at 40% of the cost.

ALIBABA 🔥:
- Qwen4-Max is in preview on Alibaba's Token Plan, QwenWork, Qoder, and the Qwen app.

MINIMAX 🔥:
- MiniMax H3-Image is a new open-weight model that makes 4K images in about 10 seconds.

STRIPE 🔥:
- Stripe has completed its acquisition of OpenRouter.

ELEVENLABS 🔥:
- ElevenLabs launched Scribe v3 and Scribe v3 Live, its most accurate speech-to-text models yet.

Rayline has launched ARC, a tiny AI model designed to pick which model should handle each step of a task and how much it should think.

Users can send a task to ARC and have it automatically assign easy steps to a lighter model and hard ones to a stronger model, for a faster, more cost-efficient experience.

In Rayline's DeepSWE tests, ARC scored 68.7% versus 69.9% for Opus 5.5, while dropping the cost to 7% per task.

Instead of generating text token by token, it’s built for closed-set choices scoring up to 1,000 questions across text, images, audio, video + PDFs in a single pass. A few details:

- 3 decision types: yes/no, multiple choice (up to 255 options) + rubric scoring
- $0.10 / 1M input tokens with $0 billed for output tokens (~5x cheaper than Flash-Lite)
- leads on several benchmark evals with lowest calibration error
